guards: Unchanged exact source root/record/sense/frame/profile/context only; preserve all source usage tags.
Apply original positive source-form normalizer and known-English-inflection guards; no suffix inference, accent folding, clitic or mandatory-SE inference.
it-only admits only supported literal third-singular entity reading; formal usted is not an English it reading, no personal imperative fallback.
All approvals retain progressive only as selected background-process reading, not universal aspect equivalence.
Generic objects explicitly in definitions are permissible lexical frames; no actual referents, examples, destinations or hidden subjects invented.
EDRAR must retain both original and target raw hashes, selected BINAR sense and reciprocal synonym proof.
Counts are reviewed source frames/form records, not independently measured new runtime coverage.
